title: Water
info: Water helps your body every day.
Drink water with meals and when you feel thirsty, especially when you play and get warm.
Juice and milk are drinks too, but water is the everyday thirst drink.

questions.q: You may need more water when
options: you have been running and feel hot
you are asleep all day without waking
you never move and it is cold only, always
